Conditional Vars: Show Variables.description: Insert the show-vars shortcode to display resolved values from _variables.yml.

Conditional Vars: Block When.description: Insert a fenced div shown only when a variable condition matches.

Conditional Vars: Block Unless.description: Insert a fenced div shown only when a variable condition does not match.

Conditional Vars: Inline When.description: Insert inline content gated by a when-var condition.

Conditional Vars: Inline Unless.description: Insert inline content gated by an unless-var condition.

Conditional Vars: Combined Conditions.description: Insert a block combining explicit when- and unless- prefixed conditions.
